A SHARED THREAD
The Lord's coming
One of the threads that run through every collection.
The Lord's coming

The same Greek word, parousia ("coming, presence"), names Christ's return in 1 Corinthians, 1 and 2 Thessalonians, James ("the coming of the Lord draweth nigh"), 2 Peter ("where is the promise of his coming?") and 1 John (counted in the site's Greek text). Deissmann showed it was the everyday word for the state visit of a king or emperor. Hebrews says instead that Christ will "appear the second time"; Titus and 1 Peter speak of his "appearing" and of "the end of all things". 1 Corinthians 15:23 1 Thessalonians 4:15–17 2 Thessalonians 2:1 James 5:7–8 2 Peter 3:4 1 John 2:28 +3 more [3]
